title: An artifact-only run turns its pipeline review off
description: Start an isolated gateway with engine start disabled. Through the checkout-local CLI, preview and create an artifact-only dev run with --no-pipeline-review, read it back with run.get, and check that dispatch.preview and run.create refuse pipelineReview none on update-branch, without artifact-only and for an unknown value. Then, on a second isolated gateway and node with the engine running, a scripted worker commits one change in a reviewed interactive dev run with pipelineReview none: REVIEW records the pipeline-review-off skip, no reviewer context exists, and COMPLETE runs. The project has review on, and the node's codex and claude are fixtures that refuse, so no model is reached.

no-pipeline-review.intent: An artifact-only dev run keeps its pipeline review off and reads it back; every request it could not honor is refused and creates nothing.

review-skip.intent: A run with its pipeline review off reaches REVIEW, skips it with its reason recorded, launches no reviewer and goes on to COMPLETE.
